name: Morgan
bio: Morgan’s true passion is working with dogs and she loves making owners feel comfortable with leaving dogs in our care. She brings 6+ years of dog industry experience to our team and her goal is to become a Dog Trainer for the Silverdale facility. She owns 2 dogs, Levi (Border Collie cross) and Georgia (St. Bernard cross), and is always trying new enrichment activities and obedience training for them. Morgan loves camping and hiking with her dogs (rain or shine), and she enjoys balancing outdoor activity with a good snuggle or movie on the couch.
